scenarios.title: Pod stuck Pending — insufficient CPU/memory request
Pod stuck Pending — node has NoSchedule taint, pod has no matching toleration
scenarios.notes: Only scenario exercising get_node_conditions' taints field

scenarios.title: Pod stuck Pending — nodeSelector references a label no node has
scenarios.notes: Tests whether agent lists nodes and checks labels vs assuming capacity issue

scenarios.title: Node under DiskPressure/MemoryPressure, pods evicted cluster-wide
scenarios.notes: Exercises conditions field of get_node_conditions, distinct from taints

scenarios.title: PVC stuck Pending — no StorageClass matches / no PV available
scenarios.notes: First test exercising storage kinds at all

scenarios.title: Pod stuck ContainerCreating — volume mount failure (PVC bound but wrong access mode)
scenarios.notes: Tests discrimination between PVC-never-bound vs bound-but-unmountable

scenarios.title: StatefulSet pod stuck — PVC template references nonexistent StorageClass
Deployment scale-up fails silently — namespace ResourceQuota exhausted
scenarios.notes: Tricky: root cause only visible in ReplicaSet events, not pod events. High-value discrimination test

scenarios.title: Pod creation rejected — LimitRange enforces a max the pod spec exceeds
scenarios.notes: Tests tracing admission-time rejection to a namespace-level policy object

scenarios.title: HPA not scaling up despite high CPU — metrics-server unavailable, HPA shows unknown target
scenarios.notes: Two-hop root cause: HPA stuck -> metrics pipeline broken

scenarios.title: HPA scaling correctly but max replicas capped below actual demand
scenarios.notes: Red-herring/Tier 4 style — correct answer is 'config limits it', not 'autoscaling broken'

scenarios.title: Pod-to-pod connectivity blocked — restrictive NetworkPolicy denies ingress
scenarios.notes: Critical: check_service_connectivity returns ready endpoints=true, agent must not stop there

scenarios.title: Egress blocked — pod can't reach external dependency due to default-deny egress policy
scenarios.notes: Distinct log signature from ingress-deny case

scenarios.title: ServiceAccount missing permissions — pod's controller logic fails with Forbidden in logs
scenarios.notes: Also exercises cluster-scoped namespace-ignoring code path — worth a dedicated unit test independent of the eval

scenarios.title: Deployment rollout stuck mid-progress — new ReplicaSet pods failing readiness
scenarios.notes: Tests comparing old vs new ReplicaSet, not just describing one pod

scenarios.title: Rollout 'completed' per rollout_status but app is functionally broken
scenarios.notes: Red herring: rollout_status says success, correct diagnosis must not trust that as proof of health

scenarios.title: Secret exists but wrong key referenced (secretKeyRef.key mismatch)
scenarios.notes: Distinct from 'ConfigMap missing' — object exists, key reference is wrong

scenarios.title: Ingress routes to wrong Service port, or pathType/host rule doesn't match
scenarios.notes: Same 'service itself is fine' discriminator pattern as networkpolicy-ingress-deny, different layer. Currently a total coverage gap.

priority_legend.eval: Full LLM-graded scenario: manifest + expected-answer JSON + tests/evals test
priority_legend.unit: Mocked pytest only, no cluster/LLM needed — verifies tool code logic
priority_legend.eval+unit: Needs both — unit test for the tool-level code path, eval for agent reasoning quality
priority_legend.skip: Documented gap only, note in docs/production-next-steps.md, no test built for the 2-3 week timeline
